# Code ID & GrowthBook | First Meeting
Date: 2026-08-28 | Duration: 56.16999816894531m

## Summary
The discussion focused on the client's need for GrowthBook integration in their telco mobile app projects, emphasizing compliance and technical feasibility. Petticot ID, working with 150 engineers primarily using the AWS ecosystem, seeks GrowthBook's assistance for feature flagging that they cannot enable themselves. GrowthBook's team introduced their roles, emphasizing flexible integration and support for regulated industries. The client wishes to involve end customers in future discussions, while GrowthBook plans to provide informational resources and detailed comparisons between tiers. The pricing model includes base licenses and seat-based fees, with interest in developing local partnerships to enhance market presence. The meeting concluded with agreements on follow-up actions and ongoing collaboration.

## Keywords
Feature Flagging, A/B Testing, Self Hosting, Product Analytics, Telco Integration, Data Sovereignty

# CODE ID & GrowthBook | Commercial Structure + Technical Questions
Date: 2026-09-04 | Duration: 74.08999633789062m

## Summary
The discussion covered GrowthBook’s integration and technical capabilities, including Google Analytics support through the SDK and data warehouse, mobile feature flagging based on user attributes and bucketing, and guardrail metrics that can trigger automatic rollback. Error tracking is not native to the SDK, so error data must come from external sources such as a data warehouse; Google Crashlytics is not directly integrated. The customer has 50 million monthly users and 5–10 million daily active users, while Herru is acting as an intermediary because the telco client cannot purchase directly through AWS. GrowthBook supports unlimited environments, ramp-up controls, approvals, APIs, webhooks, and multiple data sources. Enterprise pricing was described as a $50,000–$100,000 base license plus user fees, with $1,000 annually per user seat, while the client reported an AWS private offer of approximately $22,500 annually for 10 seats. Marcel will verify the discrepancy, provide documentation and commercial details, and continue contract discussions. A Monday afternoon meeting was proposed to finalize terms and enable implementation quickly.

## Keywords
GrowthBook integration, Google Analytics, feature flags, enterprise licensing, data warehouse, automatic rollback
